第二十三章 任务栏-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

爻雪这个任务栏一出现，立刻就吸引了此时正在店里吃饭的几人的注意。

李磊是率先注意到异常的。

他来到任务栏面前，将上面的内容仔仔细细地看了一遍，其中大多数都是一些收集物资的任务，而且都是长期任务，也就是说，只要这个任务还在，就能够一直接，积分虽然不多，但胜在比猎杀外面的那些怪物要安全的多。

除了这些收集物资的任务之外，其中最引人注目的就是最上面的那个闪着金光的任务了。

秘境探索。

需要绘制秘境地图、调查环境及其中生物等，虽然任务积分很高，但并非每个接取任务的人都能拿到这么多积分，而是根据任务完成程度给予相应积分。

而且想要接取这个任务还有一个前置条件，那就是需要接取至少三个收集物资的任务才行。

就在这时，其他人也围了上来，在看清任务栏上的任务后，其中一名看上去比较年轻的青年对爻雪问道：“店长，你这里的任务是真的假的？”

“当然是真的，那这种东西跟你们开玩笑又没有什么好处。”爻雪说道。

“那我这个算不算完成任务？”

说着青年将自己放在脚边的背包给拿了起来。

他表情用力，可以看出背包里面装的东西一点都不轻，之前爻雪也注意到了，还以为背包里面装的是什么宝贝呢。

但看青年将背包随手丢在地上的那不在意的样子，她又觉得自己猜错了。

青年将背包放在柜台上，拉开拉链，将里面的东西展露出来，竟然是整整半背包的书，准确地说应该是漫画。

虽然是差不多的世界，但爻雪本身对漫画并不了解，所以她也不清楚这些漫画到底是哪部作品，不过看这人连末世都舍不得丢掉，这应该是一部经典作品吧。

“店长，这些漫画行不行？”青年一脸期待的看着爻雪问道，“你发布的任务栏里面就有收集书籍这一项，漫画应该也算书吧。”

爻雪看着这些漫画，好半晌之后才缓缓地点了点头，说道：“自然是算的，不过你的这些漫画应该不是全部吧，而且还有破损。”

As soon as the task bar of Yaoxue appeared, it immediately attracted the attention of several people who were eating in the store at this time.

Li Lei was the first to notice the abnormality.

He came to the task bar and read the contents carefully. Most of them were tasks to collect supplies, and they were long-term tasks. In other words, as long as the task was still there, he could continue to do it. Although the points were not many, it was much safer than hunting the monsters outside.

In addition to these tasks of collecting supplies, the most eye-catching one is the shining golden task at the top.

Secret exploration.

It is necessary to draw a map of the secret realm, investigate the environment and the creatures in it, etc. Although the task points are very high, not everyone who accepts the task can get so many points. Instead, corresponding points will be awarded according to the degree of completion of the task.

Moreover, there is a prerequisite for accepting this mission, which is that you need to accept at least three missions to collect supplies.

At this moment, other people gathered around. After seeing the tasks on the task bar, one of the younger-looking young people asked Yaoxue: "Store manager, are the tasks you have here real or fake?"

"Of course it's true, so there's no point in joking with you about this kind of thing," Yaoxue said.

"Does this count as completing my mission?"

As he spoke, the young man picked up the backpack he had placed at his feet.

His expression was strong, and it could be seen that the contents of the backpack were not light at all. Yaoxue had noticed it before and thought that there was some kind of treasure in the backpack.

But looking at the young man's nonchalant look as he threw his backpack on the ground, she felt that she had guessed wrong.

The young man put the backpack on the counter, opened the zipper, and revealed the contents. It turned out to be half a backpack full of books, to be precise, they should be comics.

Although it's a similar world, Yaoxue doesn't know much about comics, so she doesn't know which works these comics are. But seeing that this person is reluctant to throw away even the end of the world, this should be a classic work.

"Store manager, are these comics okay?" The young man looked at Yaoxue expectantly and asked, "The task list you posted includes collecting books. Comics should also count as books."

Yaoxue looked at these comics, and after a long while, she nodded slowly and said: "Of course it counts, but these comics of yours should not be all, and they are still damaged."
